subject: Tourism
examFormat: A composite paper of Papers 1 and 2, answered in 2 hours 30 minutes. Paper 1 has 40 multiple-choice questions covering the entire syllabus, all to be answered in 40 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2 has Section A, ten restricted-response essay questions all to be answered for 40 marks (about 50 minutes), and Section B, five essay questions of which candidates answer any three for 60 marks in one hour. Field work (excursions to tourism sites) is assessed in school continuous assessment and accounts for 40 per cent of the continuous assessment scores.

subtopics.name: Concepts of Tourism
objectives: Define tourism, tourist, visitor, tour, operation, excursion, recreation, leisure, hospitality, travel, etc.

subtopics.name: Scope of Tourism
objectives: Describe the scope of tourism

subtopics.name: History of Tourism
objectives: Outline the history of tourism

subtopics.name: Types of Tourism
objectives: Identify the types of tourism (domestic, international)
Identify the forms of tourism: incoming/inbound, out-coming/outbound, international, domestic, long haul, short haul, business, eco/environmental, cultural, religious, sport and youth

subtopics.name: Components of Tourism
objectives: Identify the components of tourism: attraction, accessibility and amenities

subtopics.name: Tourist Product
objectives: Define the tourist product
State the characteristics of tourist products (heterogeneous, intangible, immovable)

subtopics.name: Tourist Attractions in a Nation
objectives: Identify tourist attractions and their locations: natural (national parks, scenic features, beaches, coasts, landforms, etc.), man-made (monuments, museums, palaces, etc.) and social cultural (historical monuments, festivals, carnivals, sports, etc.)

subtopics.name: Tourism Statistics
objectives: Explain the meaning of tourism statistics: inflow (arrival), outflow (departure), expenditure pattern and data collection
State the importance of tourism statistics

subtopics.name: Benefits of Tourism
objectives: State the economic benefits: financial, taxes, levies, balance of payments, foreign exchange earnings, etc.
State the social benefits: cultural understanding, job creation and international co-operation
State the developmental benefits: infrastructure (road, light, water, communication), superstructure (buildings, flyovers) and rural development (preserves nature, use of land)

topics.name: Festivals and Heritages in a Nation
objectives: Identify festivals in Nigeria, e.g. Argungu International Fishing Festival, Oshogbo International Festival, New Yam festival, Shao mass wedding, Sharo festival and Fare Wrestling Festival
Identify heritages in a nation, e.g. Sukur World Heritage site, museums and monuments, art galleries, palaces, Gidan Makama and shrines

topics.name: Reasons for Travel
objectives: Explain why people travel
Identify physiological factors: visit to friends and relations, holidays and health
Identify economic factors: business/shopping, conferences/meetings and trade fairs/exhibitions
Identify social factors: religion, sports, beautiful natural sceneries, fashion fair, education and self esteem

topics.name: Business and Entrepreneurial Skills in Tourism

subtopics.name: Travel Agency Business
objectives: Explain the meaning of travel agency/agent
State the roles/functions of a travel agent: reservation, ticketing, visa procurement, foreign exchange procurement, etc.

State the qualities of a travel agent: resourcefulness, marketing skills, honesty/integrity, good communication skills, timeliness, vision, managerial ability, good understanding of ICT, creativity, etc.

subtopics.name: Tour Operating Business
objectives: Define a tour operator
State the roles of a tour operator: packaging, marketing and executing

State the qualities of a tour operator: honesty, good public relations, good marketing skills, good financial standing, good knowledge of the environment, innovativeness, good understanding of ICT, etc.

subtopics.name: Support Services
objectives: Identify support groups in travel business: financial support (insurance, banking, bureau de change), transport facilities/car hire services, souvenir shops, accommodation/hotel and catering services, health services and security services

subtopics.name: Public Agencies in Tourism
objectives: Identify the public agencies in tourism and their roles: Federal Ministry of Tourism, Culture and National Orientation, State Tourism Boards, Local Government Tourism Committees and parastatals
State the roles of NTDC (policy implementation), NIHOTOUR (manpower development) and NCMM (preservation of heritages)

subtopics.name: Private Agencies in Tourism
objectives: Identify the private tourism agencies in Nigeria and their roles: FTAN, NANTA, the Association of Nigerian Journalists and Writers on Tourism, NATOP, the Nigerian Hotels Association and HATMAN

subtopics.name: Tourism Marketing
objectives: Explain the meaning of tourism marketing
Identify tourism marketing strategies: segmentation, mass marketing and niche marketing

Identify marketing tools in tourism: electronic media (television, radio), print media (newspapers, magazines, journals, publications), fairs and exhibitions (local and international) and e-tourism (internet services, e-banking, e-reservation, electronic billboard)

subtopics.name: Entrepreneurship in Tourism
objectives: Explain the meaning of entrepreneurship
Explain the meaning of cottage industries
Give examples of cottage industries: leather works, ceramics and pottery, bread making, tie and dye, hair weaving, painting, cloth weaving, raffia weaving, etc.
Identify items produced in cottage industries, e.g. shoes, bags, water pots, tiles, beads, ornaments, clothes, adire, cane chairs and raffia beds

subtopics.name: Service Delivery in Tourism
objectives: Explain the meaning of service delivery
Identify service delivery roles in tourism: tour guides, ticket retailers, cooks, waiters, photographers, cultural dancers, drivers, game guards, reservation officers, etc.

subtopics.name: Skill Acquisition
objectives: Define skills
Identify skill acquisition centres in a nation: SMEDAN, NDE, NIHOTOUR, NICO, Ushafa Pottery Centre, etc.
